description: Transparent scoring configuration. Weights are normalised at runtime; change them or override with CLI priorities. Scores are heuristics, not predictions.
effective_rain_note: Fraction of growing-season precipitation assumed plant-available after runoff and evaporation. A planning assumption, not a measured water balance.

water_balance.label: Water balance
water_balance.description: Compares indicative crop water demand with effective growing-season precipitation. Penalises demand above the assumed available rain; does not model irrigation efficiency.

soil_health.label: Soil health
soil_health.description: Combines nitrogen-fixation potential, residue/organic-matter contribution, and rooting depth, with a bonus for legume frequency.

erosion_control.label: Erosion control
erosion_control.description: Combines crop residue/cover class with terrain slope. Steeper fields increase the penalty for bare or low-cover phases.

forage_value.label: Forage / livestock
forage_value.description: Average indicative forage value of the rotation. Relevant only if the farm has livestock.

market_fit.label: Market fit
market_fit.description: Qualitative market suitability plus crop diversity. Local prices, contracts, and processing access are NOT modelled.

resilience.label: Resilience
resilience.description: Crop/family diversity, drought-tolerance classes, and penalties for consecutive monoculture or same-family sequences.

agronomic_fit.label: Agronomic fit
agronomic_fit.description: pH, texture, drainage and salinity compatibility with the field's SoilGrids context, plus growing-duration fit to the available season.

adjustments.legume_frequency_note: Added to soil-health score when at least one third of seasons are legumes, scaled by nitrogen-fixation potential.
